Class PaymentController

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.controller.PaymentController
public class PaymentController extends Object
Controller for the cashier's payment screen (payment-view.fxml). Takes an optional tip and a cash or card payment for the order in the Cart, saves the order, and then lets the cashier start a new order.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called by JavaFX after the FXML is loaded. Reads the subtotal from the cart and shows it along with the amount due.

    • updateAmountDue

      private void updateAmountDue()
      Shows the subtotal plus the tip as the amount due. Runs when the screen opens and each time a key is released in the tip field; a blank or invalid tip counts as zero.

    • handleCompletePayment

      private void handleCompletePayment()
      Checks the payment and saves the order in the background. Called by the Complete Payment button.

      A negative tip is rejected. For a cash payment, the cash received must cover the subtotal plus the tip, and the change is shown; a card payment skips that check. While the order saves, Complete Payment and Back are disabled so the order cannot be submitted twice. On success the cart is cleared, the new order number is shown, and the New Order button appears. On failure the buttons are enabled again so the cashier can retry, and the cart is kept.

    • handleBack

      private void handleBack()
      Returns to the order summary without paying. Called by the Back button. The cart is unchanged.

    • handleReturnToMenu

      private void handleReturnToMenu()
      Returns to the main cashier screen to start the next order. Called by the New Order button, which only appears after a payment is saved.

    • parseOrZero

      Reads a dollar amount typed by the cashier.

      Returns:
